description_en: Verifies the authenticity and consistency of a phone number, name, and ID card number against an authoritative data source. If the information is inconsistent, returns the reason for the inconsistency
description_zh: 传入手机号、姓名、身份证号，通过权威数据源验证其真实性和一致性，如果不一致，返回不一致的原因
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl mobile-3-meta-verify-intl --product-code MOBILE_3META --param-type normal --identify-num 429001000000008211 --user-name '张0' --mobile 18600001234 --region cn-hangzhou
name: Mobile3MetaVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en: The product solution code. Fixed value: MOBILE_3META
parameters.help_zh: 接入的产品方案，固定值：MOBILE_3META
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The parameter type. Valid values:

normal: not encrypted
md5: MD5-encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
参数类型：

normal：不加密
md5：md5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID card number.

If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
身份证号

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: identify_num

parameters.help_en:
The name.

If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
姓名

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The phone number.

If ParamType is set to normal, enter the plaintext value.
If ParamType is set to md5, enter a 32-character lowercase MD5 string
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码。

当paramType取值normal时，输入明文
当paramType取值md5时，输入32位小写md5字符串
parameters.name: mobile

BizCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:
1: Consistent.
2: Inconsistent.
3: No record found
BizCode.description_zh:
核验结果码。
1：核验一致
2：核验不一致
3：未查得

IspName.description_en:
The carrier name. Valid values:

CMCC: China Mobile
CUCC: China Unicom
CTCC: China Telecom
IspName.description_zh:
运营商名称

CMCC：移动
CUCC：联通
CTCC：电信

SubCode.description_en:
The detailed verification result. Valid values:

101: Verification passed. 
201: The phone number is inconsistent with the name, and the phone number is inconsistent with the ID card number. 
202: The phone number is consistent with the name, but the phone number is inconsistent with the ID card number. 
203: The phone number is consistent with the ID card number, but the phone number is inconsistent with the name. 
204: Other inconsistency.
301: No record found
SubCode.description_zh:
核验详细结果

101:验证通过 
201:⼿机号和姓名不⼀致，⼿机号和证件号不⼀致 
202:⼿机号和姓名⼀致，⼿机号和证件号不⼀致 
203:⼿机号和证件号⼀致，⼿机号和姓名不⼀致 
204:其他不⼀致
301:查⽆记录
